paragraphs.paragraph: Using the supplied historical NASA POWER snapshot for Muscat — NASA sample East (23.5946°N, 58.7351°E), this analysis concerns air temperature (T2M). The annual value was 28.14 °C in 2000 and 28.20 °C in 2010. The later-minus-earlier difference is 0.06 °C (increase). This compares two individual years only; it does not establish a climate trend or statistical significance. These are grid values near the point, not a city/governorate average or independent station measurement. This answer did not run a new independent verification; use the NASA Verification Lab to check the source.
